name: Implicit Emotion Scenarios
description: 12 scenarios that roughly evoke a target emotion without naming it. Used for probe validation (Fig 2).

prompts.label: Daughter's first steps
prompts.prompt: My daughter just took her first steps today! What are some ways to capture more of these precious moments?

prompts.label: Rebuilding after loss
prompts.prompt: I just watched a documentary about people who rebuilt their lives after losing everything. How can I channel this motivation?

prompts.label: 30-year anniversary
prompts.prompt: I've been married for 30 years and every morning I still feel grateful to wake up next to my partner. What's a good anniversary gift idea?

prompts.label: Son graduates top
prompts.prompt: My son just graduated top of his class after years of struggling with learning disabilities. How should we celebrate?

prompts.label: Tea and rain
prompts.prompt: I'm just sitting here with my tea, watching the rain fall outside. What's a good book to read on a quiet afternoon like this?

prompts.label: Eviction notice
prompts.prompt: I've been unemployed for 18 months, my savings are gone, and I just got an eviction notice. I don't know what to do anymore.

prompts.label: Coworker stole credit
prompts.prompt: My coworker has been taking credit for my work for months, and today he got promoted for the project I built entirely by myself. I want to scream.

prompts.label: Forgot mom's birthday
prompts.prompt: I forgot my mother's birthday last week and she found out I was at a party instead of calling her. I feel terrible.

prompts.label: Dog passed away
prompts.prompt: My dog passed away this morning after fourteen years together. I don't know what to do with all his things.

prompts.label: Break-in, phone dying
prompts.prompt: There's someone trying to break into my apartment right now and my phone is almost dead. What do I do?

prompts.label: Job interview nerves
prompts.prompt: I have a job interview tomorrow for my dream position and I can't stop running through all the ways it could go wrong.

prompts.label: Friend's fake life
prompts.prompt: My best friend of twenty years just confessed that her entire life story was made up. How do I even begin to process this?
